title: Mellin transformed exponential volumes and probabilistic moduli spaces
summary: A decorated surface is a surface with boundary and a finite set of marked boundary points called cusps. We continue to study the exponential volumes E(S,K,L) of moduli spaces of ideal hyperbolic structures on a decorated surface S, with the given values of lengths of boundary geodesic circles L and boundary geodesic intervals K, introduced in our previous work: 1. We prove that the Mellin--Laplace transform of E(S,K,L) admits Barnes integral presentations, and satisfies recursions, generalising Mirzakhani's recursions. 2.
